capital.en: No capital; ceremonial centres such as Mound City and Newark (Ohio)
capital.zh: 无首都；以俄亥俄州芒德城、纽瓦克等礼仪中心为核心

summary.en: The Hopewell were not a state but a network of societies across the Ohio and Illinois valleys, linked by trade in obsidian, copper, mica and shell and by the building of vast geometric earthworks. Its ceremonial centres in southern Ohio flourished from about 1 to 500 CE.
summary.zh: 霍普韦尔并非国家，而是俄亥俄河与伊利诺伊河流域诸社会组成的网络，通过黑曜石、铜、云母和贝壳贸易以及修建巨大的几何形土方工程相互联结。其位于俄亥俄州南部的礼仪中心约在公元1至500年间兴盛。

sources.title: National Park Service: Hopewell Culture National Historical Park
UNESCO World Heritage: Hopewell Ceremonial Earthworks

note: An archaeological culture rather than a polity; dates are conventional (roughly 100 BCE–500 CE, clipped to the atlas range). No rulers are known by name.

capital.en: No capital; large villages such as Snaketown on the Gila River
capital.zh: 无首都；以吉拉河畔斯内克敦等大型村落为中心

summary.en: In the Sonoran Desert of what is now Arizona, the Hohokam built the largest prehistoric canal system in North America, irrigating maize, beans, squash and cotton along the Salt and Gila rivers. Ballcourts and later platform mounds marked their towns, and the society broke apart around 1450.
summary.zh: 在今亚利桑那州的索诺兰沙漠，霍霍坎人修建了北美最大的史前运河系统，沿索尔特河与吉拉河灌溉玉米、豆类、南瓜和棉花。球场与后期的平台土丘是其聚落的标志，这一社会约在1450年前后瓦解。

sources.title: National Park Service: Casa Grande Ruins National Monument

note: Conventional span (c. 300–1450/1500 CE); start dates vary by scholar from 1 CE to 450 CE. No named rulers.

name.zh: 查科峡谷体系（古普韦布洛人）

capital.zh: 查科峡谷（博尼托普韦布洛）

summary.en: From about 850 to 1150, Chaco Canyon in northwestern New Mexico was the centre of an Ancestral Puebloan world, with multi-storey great houses, straight roads and outlying communities over the San Juan Basin. Drought and shifting power moved the focus north to Aztec and Mesa Verde.
summary.zh: 约850至1150年间，新墨西哥州西北部的查科峡谷是古普韦布洛世界的中心，拥有多层“大屋”、笔直的道路，以及遍布圣胡安盆地的外围聚落。干旱与权力转移使重心北移至阿兹特克遗址和梅萨维德。

sources.title: National Park Service: Chaco Culture National Historical Park

note: The QID is for the Ancestral Puebloan people as a whole; how centralised Chaco was is debated. No named rulers.

name.zh: 密西西比文化（卡霍基亚）

capital.zh: 卡霍基亚（今圣路易斯附近）

summary.en: Maize farming chiefdoms built platform mounds across the Mississippi and Southeast from about 800. The greatest, Cahokia, grew suddenly around 1050 into a town of perhaps 10,000–20,000 people with the hundred-foot Monks Mound, then declined after 1200 and was empty by about 1350. Other centres, such as Moundville and Etowah, lasted into the 1500s.
summary.zh: 约自800年起，种植玉米的酋邦在密西西比河流域和美国东南部修建平台土丘。其中最大的卡霍基亚约在1050年骤然兴起，人口或达一万至两万，拥有约30米高的僧侣丘；1200年后衰落，约1350年已无人居住。芒德维尔、埃托瓦等其他中心则延续到16世纪。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage: Cahokia Mounds State Historic Site
Timothy R. Pauketat, Cahokia: Ancient America's Great City on the Mississippi (2009)

note: Archaeological dates; Cahokia's own peak is c. 1050–1200 and its abandonment c. 1350, while Mississippian chiefdoms persisted until European contact. Population estimates range widely. No named rulers.

capital.en: Brattahlíð (Eastern Settlement); bishop's seat at Garðar
capital.zh: 布拉塔利德（东定居点）；主教座堂在加达尔

summary.en: Erik the Red led Icelandic settlers to southwest Greenland around 985, founding the Eastern and Western Settlements, which at their height held perhaps 2,000–3,000 people. A bishopric was set up at Garðar in 1126 and the colony accepted Norwegian rule in 1261. The Western Settlement was empty by about 1350 and the last record dates from 1408.
summary.zh: 约985年，红发埃里克率冰岛移民来到格陵兰西南部，建立了东、西两个定居点，鼎盛时或有两三千人。1126年在加达尔设立主教区，1261年殖民地接受挪威统治。西定居点约在1350年已荒废，最后的文献记录是1408年的一场婚礼。

name.zh: 挪威国王马格努斯六世
玛格丽特一世（卡尔马联盟）

sources.title: Kirsten A. Seaver, The Frozen Echo: Greenland and the Exploration of North America (1996)
UNESCO World Heritage: Kujataa Greenland: Norse and Inuit Farming at the Edge of the Ice Cap
National Museum of Denmark: The Norse in Greenland

note: The end date is approximate: the last written record is from 1408 and the Eastern Settlement was abandoned sometime in the mid-15th century. Erik and Leif were paramount chieftains, not kings; their dates are approximate.

name.zh: 豪德诺索尼（易洛魁）联盟

capital.zh: 奥农达加（中央议事之火）

summary.en: The Mohawk, Oneida, Onondaga, Cayuga and Seneca nations united under the Great Law of Peace, with a Grand Council of fifty chiefs, the rotiyanershon, chosen by clan mothers, meeting at Onondaga. The Tuscarora joined around 1722. Powerful in the colonial wars, the Confederacy split during the American Revolution but its Grand Council continues today.
summary.zh: 莫霍克、奥奈达、奥农达加、卡尤加和塞内卡五族依据《和平大法》结成联盟，由氏族母亲推选的五十位酋长组成大议会，在奥农达加集会。约1722年塔斯卡罗拉人加入。联盟在殖民战争中举足轻重，美国革命期间发生分裂，但其大议会延续至今。

name.zh: 和平使者（德甘纳维达），联合创立者
海华沙（阿延瓦塔），联合创立者
亨德里克·西亚诺金（莫霍克发言人）
卡纳萨蒂戈（奥农达加发言人）
约瑟夫·布兰特（塔延达尼加）

sources.title: Daniel K. Richter, The Ordeal of the Longhouse (1992)

note: The founding date is disputed: oral tradition and some scholars argue for c. 1142, others for c. 1450–1600. The Confederacy has no single ruler; the people listed are founders and prominent spokesmen, with approximate dates of prominence.

capital.zh: 魁北克

summary.en: France claimed the St. Lawrence after Jacques Cartier's 1534 voyage and built a colony from Québec (1608), Montréal and later Louisiana. Ruled from 1663 as a royal province by a governor and an intendant, it relied on the fur trade and Indigenous alliances. It was conquered in 1759–60 and ceded to Britain and Spain in 1763.
summary.zh: 雅克·卡蒂埃1534年航行之后，法国宣称拥有圣劳伦斯河流域，并以魁北克（1608年）、蒙特利尔及后来的路易斯安那为基础建立殖民地。1663年起作为王室领地由总督与总督府监督官共同治理，依赖毛皮贸易与原住民联盟。1759至1760年被英军征服，1763年割让给英国和西班牙。

name.en: Louis de Buade de Frontenac (1st term)
name.zh: 弗隆特纳克伯爵（第一任期）

name.en: Louis de Buade de Frontenac (2nd term)
name.zh: 弗隆特纳克伯爵（第二任期）
菲利普·德·里戈·德·沃德勒伊

name.en: Charles de la Boische, Marquis de Beauharnois
Pierre de Rigaud, Marquis de Vaudreuil-Cavagnial
name.zh: 沃德勒伊-卡瓦尼亚尔侯爵

sources.title: Canadian Museum of History: Virtual Museum of New France

note: Champlain was the colony's leader from 1608 but held a formal commission as commander only from 1612 (lieutenant to the viceroy).

capital.zh: 圣阿古斯丁

summary.en: After Ponce de León's 1513 landfall and failed expeditions, Spain fixed its hold on Florida with St. Augustine in 1565, guarding the treasure-fleet route. A chain of Franciscan missions reached Apalachee and Guale but was destroyed by English and allied raids around 1702–1706. Florida was British from 1763 to 1783, then Spanish again until its cession to the United States in 1821.
summary.zh: 1513年庞塞·德莱昂登陆、此后多次远征失败之后，西班牙于1565年以圣奥古斯丁巩固了对佛罗里达的控制，以守护运宝船队航线。方济各会传教站链一度延伸至阿巴拉契和瓜莱，但在1702至1706年前后被英国人及其盟友摧毁。佛罗里达1763至1783年属英国，此后重归西班牙，1821年割让给美国。

name.zh: 佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德·阿维莱斯
比森特·曼努埃尔·德·塞斯佩德斯

sources.title: Michael Gannon (ed.), The History of Florida (2013)

note: Spanish claims date from 1513; this record starts with permanent settlement in 1565. The span includes the British period of 1763–1783 (East and West Florida) as an interruption.

capital.zh: 圣菲（1610年起；此前为圣加夫列尔）

summary.en: Juan de Oñate led colonists up the Río Grande in 1598 to found the northern frontier province of New Spain, with Santa Fe as its capital from 1610. Forced labour and religious persecution provoked the Pueblo Revolt of 1680, which drove the Spanish out until Diego de Vargas returned in 1692. It became part of independent Mexico in 1821.
summary.zh: 1598年，胡安·德·奥尼亚特率移民沿格兰德河北上，建立新西班牙的北部边疆省份，1610年起以圣菲为首府。强迫劳役和宗教迫害引发了1680年的普韦布洛起义，西班牙人被逐出，直到1692年迭戈·德·巴尔加斯重新进入。1821年它成为独立后的墨西哥的一部分。

sources.title: John L. Kessell, Pueblos, Spaniards, and the Kingdom of New Mexico (2008)
Wikipedia: Santa Fe de Nuevo México

note: Spanish rule was interrupted by the Pueblo Revolt (1680–1692). Wikidata ends the province in 1824, when Mexico made it a territory; this record ends at Mexican independence (1821), after which the mesoamerica dataset covers Mexico.

capital.en: Governed from London; each colony had its own capital
capital.zh: 由伦敦管辖；各殖民地另有首府

summary.en: From Jamestown (1607) and Plymouth (1620) English colonies spread along the Atlantic seaboard until there were thirteen, from New Hampshire to Georgia (1732). Each had its own assembly and charter or royal governor under the Crown and Parliament. After 1763, new taxes and the closing of the West drove them to declare independence in 1776.
summary.zh: 从詹姆斯敦（1607年）和普利茅斯（1620年）开始，英国殖民地沿大西洋海岸扩展，最终从新罕布什尔到佐治亚（1732年）共有十三个。各殖民地在王室和议会之下拥有自己的议会以及特许状或王室总督。1763年后，新税和西部的封闭促使它们在1776年宣布独立。

note: The capital pin is London, seat of the Crown and Board of Trade; there was no common colonial capital. Monarchs are those whose reigns mattered most for the colonies.

name.zh: 波瓦坦大酋邦（策纳科马卡）

capital.zh: 韦罗沃科莫科（后迁奥拉帕克斯、马丘特）

summary.en: Wahunsenacawh, the Powhatan, inherited a handful of chiefdoms and by 1607 ruled some thirty Algonquian-speaking peoples of the Virginia Tidewater, perhaps 15,000 people, from Werowocomoco on the York River. His brother Opechancanough led great uprisings against English Virginia in 1622 and 1644. After his capture and death in 1646, a treaty made the survivors tributaries of the colony.
summary.zh: 号称“波瓦坦”的瓦洪苏纳考继承了几个酋邦，到1607年已从约克河畔的韦罗沃科莫科统治弗吉尼亚潮水地带约三十个讲阿尔冈昆语的部族，人口约一万五千。其弟奥佩昌卡努于1622年和1644年领导了反抗英属弗吉尼亚的大起义。1646年他被俘遇害后，一份条约使幸存者成为殖民地的纳贡者。

name.zh: 瓦洪苏纳考（波瓦坦酋长）

sources.title: Helen C. Rountree, Pocahontas, Powhatan, Opechancanough (2005)
National Park Service: Captain John Smith Chesapeake NHT (Werowocomoco)

note: The start date is approximate (Wahunsenacawh's accession is unrecorded). Opitchapam formally succeeded in 1618, but Opechancanough held real power; he is listed from 1618.

capital.zh: 新阿姆斯特丹

summary.en: Dutch traders followed Henry Hudson's 1609 voyage up the river later named for him and set up Fort Nassau near Albany in 1614. Run by the Dutch West India Company from 1621, New Netherland stretched from the Delaware to the Connecticut. New Amsterdam on Manhattan was its capital until an English fleet took it without a fight in 1664.
summary.zh: 荷兰商人追随亨利·哈德逊1609年的航迹溯河而上（此河后以他命名），1614年在今奥尔巴尼附近建立拿骚堡。1621年起由荷兰西印度公司经营的新尼德兰从特拉华河延伸到康涅狄格河，以曼哈顿的新阿姆斯特丹为首府，直到1664年英国舰队兵不血刃将其夺取。

sources.title: Jaap Jacobs, The Colony of New Netherland (2009)

note: Wikidata gives 1609–1667 (Hudson's voyage to the Treaty of Breda); this record uses the first post (1614) and the English conquest (1664). The Dutch briefly retook the colony in 1673–74.

capital.en: Three Saints Bay and Kodiak, then Novo-Arkhangelsk (Sitka) from 1808
capital.zh: 三圣湾、科迪亚克，1808年起为新阿尔汉格尔斯克（锡特卡）

summary.en: Russian fur hunters followed Bering's 1741 voyage to the Aleutians, forcing Unangax̂ and Alutiiq men to hunt sea otters. Grigory Shelikhov founded the first permanent settlement on Kodiak in 1784, and from 1799 the Russian-American Company governed the colony. With sea otters depleted and the colony hard to defend, Russia sold Alaska to the United States in 1867.
summary.zh: 白令1741年航行之后，俄国毛皮猎人来到阿留申群岛，强迫阿留特人和阿卢蒂克人男子为其捕猎海獭。1784年，格里高利·舍利霍夫在科迪亚克岛建立第一个永久定居点；1799年起由俄美公司管理殖民地。由于海獭锐减且难以防守，俄国于1867年将阿拉斯加卖给美国。

sources.title: Lydia T. Black, Russians in Alaska, 1732–1867 (2004)
National Park Service: Sitka National Historical Park

note: Wikidata starts Russian America in 1772 (an earlier Unalaska trading post); this record uses the first permanent settlement (1784). Shelikhov never lived in Alaska after 1786 and directed it from Irkutsk.

capital.en: Washington, D.C. (from 1800; New York and Philadelphia before)
capital.zh: 华盛顿哥伦比亚特区（1800年起；此前为纽约、费城）

summary.en: Declared independent in 1776 and recognised in 1783, the republic ran under the Articles of Confederation until the Constitution took effect in 1789. It expanded to the Pacific through purchase, treaty, war and the dispossession of Indigenous nations, survived the Civil War, which ended slavery, and in the 20th century became a world power.
summary.zh: 美国于1776年宣布独立，1783年获得承认，在《邦联条例》下运行至1789年宪法生效。它通过购买、条约、战争以及对原住民族的剥夺扩张到太平洋，挺过了终结奴隶制的南北战争，并在20世纪成为世界强国。

name.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普（第二任期；第一任期2017—2021）

sources.title: Miller Center (University of Virginia): U.S. Presidents
U.S. National Archives: America's Founding Documents

note: Wikidata dates the US from 1784 (ratification of the Treaty of Paris); this record starts at the Declaration of Independence (1776). The capital pin is Washington.

capital.en: Québec (seat of the governor general); later Kingston, Montréal, Toronto and Québec in turn
capital.zh: 魁北克（总督驻地）；后由金斯顿、蒙特利尔、多伦多和魁北克轮流

summary.en: After the loss of the Thirteen Colonies, Britain's remaining North American colonies were Quebec (split in 1791 into Upper and Lower Canada), Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland and later British Columbia, with Rupert's Land under the Hudson's Bay Company. Loyalist settlement, the War of 1812, the rebellions of 1837–38 and responsible government shaped them before Confederation in 1867.
summary.zh: 失去十三殖民地后，英国在北美剩下的殖民地包括魁北克（1791年分为上、下加拿大）、新斯科舍、新不伦瑞克、爱德华王子岛、纽芬兰以及后来的不列颠哥伦比亚，鲁珀特地则归哈德逊湾公司。效忠派移民、1812年战争、1837至1838年起义和责任政府塑造了这些殖民地，直至1867年联邦成立。

name.zh: 盖伊·卡尔顿（多切斯特勋爵）
达勒姆伯爵约翰·兰姆顿
额尔金伯爵詹姆斯·布鲁斯

sources.title: The Canadian Encyclopedia: British North America
Library and Archives Canada: Governors General

note: Wikidata extends the term to 1907 (Newfoundland stayed outside Canada); this record ends at Confederation. Rulers are governors-in-chief or governors general; Monck continued as Canada's first governor general after 1867.

capital.zh: 先知镇（印第安纳州蒂珀卡努）

summary.en: The Shawnee prophet Tenskwatawa's call from 1805 to reject American goods and ways drew followers from many nations to Prophetstown on the Wabash. His brother Tecumseh turned it into a political alliance opposing any further land cessions. Defeated at Tippecanoe in 1811, it fought beside Britain in the War of 1812 and collapsed when Tecumseh was killed at the Thames in 1813.
summary.zh: 从1805年起，肖尼族先知滕斯夸塔瓦号召拒绝美国的商品与生活方式，吸引了众多部族的追随者聚集到沃巴什河畔的先知镇。其兄特库姆塞把它变成反对任何进一步割让土地的政治联盟。1811年在蒂珀卡努战败后，联盟在1812年战争中与英国并肩作战，1813年特库姆塞在泰晤士河之战中阵亡后瓦解。

sources.title: R. David Edmunds, Tecumseh and the Quest for Indian Leadership (1984)

note: Wikidata runs the confederacy to 1824; this record ends with Tecumseh's death in 1813, after which it effectively dissolved.

capital.zh: 新埃科塔（1825—1838），后为塔勒阔

summary.en: After decades of war, the Cherokee rebuilt themselves as a centralised nation with a national council, a written constitution (1827), the Cherokee Phoenix newspaper and Sequoyah's syllabary. Despite winning Worcester v. Georgia (1832), they were forced west on the Trail of Tears in 1838–39 and rebuilt their government at Tahlequah. Allotment ended its land base when Oklahoma became a state in 1907.
summary.zh: 经过数十年战争，切罗基人将自己重建为一个中央集权的民族国家，拥有全国议会、成文宪法（1827年）、《切罗基凤凰报》和塞阔雅音节文字。尽管在“伍斯特诉佐治亚州案”（1832年）中胜诉，他们仍在1838至1839年被迫沿“血泪之路”西迁，并在塔勒阔重建政府。1907年俄克拉何马建州时，土地分配制度终结了其土地基础。

note: The span follows Wikidata (1794 treaty recognition to Oklahoma statehood). The Cherokee Nation re-formed its government in the 20th century and is a federally recognised nation today (Q14708404).

capital.en: Austin (from 1839; Washington-on-the-Brazos, Houston and others before)
capital.zh: 奥斯汀（1839年起；此前在布拉索斯河畔华盛顿、休斯敦等地）

summary.en: Anglo-American settlers and Tejano allies declared Texas independent of Mexico in March 1836 and won at San Jacinto in April. The republic legalised slavery, warred with the Comanche and was never recognised by Mexico. The United States annexed it in 1845, and power passed to the new state government in February 1846, a step that led to the Mexican–American War.
summary.zh: 1836年3月，英裔美国移民与特哈诺盟友宣布得克萨斯脱离墨西哥独立，4月在圣哈辛托获胜。共和国使奴隶制合法化，与科曼奇人交战，始终未获墨西哥承认。1845年美国将其兼并，1846年2月权力移交给新的州政府，这一步导致了美墨战争。

sources.title: Texas State Historical Association: Republic of Texas
Texas State Library and Archives: Presidents of the Republic

capital.zh: 里士满（1861年5月前为蒙哥马利）

summary.en: Seven slave states seceded after Abraham Lincoln's election and formed the Confederacy in February 1861, with a constitution explicitly protecting slavery; four more joined after Fort Sumter. It fought the Union for four years, with Richmond as its capital from May 1861. It collapsed with Lee's surrender at Appomattox in April 1865 and Jefferson Davis's capture that May.
summary.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯当选后，七个蓄奴州脱离联邦，于1861年2月组成邦联，其宪法明确保护奴隶制；萨姆特堡事件后又有四州加入。邦联与联邦作战四年，自1861年5月起以里士满为首都。1865年4月李将军在阿波马托克斯投降、同年5月杰斐逊·戴维斯被俘后，邦联瓦解。

name.zh: 亚历山大·斯蒂芬斯（副总统）

sources.title: James M. McPherson, Battle Cry of Freedom (1988)

capital.zh: 渥太华

summary.en: Confederation in 1867 joined Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick in a self-governing dominion that grew from sea to sea with Rupert's Land, British Columbia and later Newfoundland (1949). Full legislative independence came with the Statute of Westminster (1931) and patriation of the Constitution with a Charter of Rights (1982). Nunavut was created in 1999.
summary.zh: 1867年联邦成立，将安大略、魁北克、新斯科舍和新不伦瑞克联合为一个自治领，随后纳入鲁珀特地、不列颠哥伦比亚以及后来的纽芬兰（1949年），疆域横跨两洋。1931年《威斯敏斯特法令》带来完全的立法独立，1982年宪法回归并附《权利与自由宪章》。1999年设立努纳武特地区。

summary.en: The Comanche, who first appear in Spanish records near New Mexico in 1706, built a horse-and-bison economy and a trading and raiding network that dominated the southern Plains. In the 1700s and 1800s they held back Spanish, Mexican and Texan expansion. Disease, the slaughter of the bison herds and the US Army's Red River War ended their independence in 1875.
summary.zh: 科曼奇人于1706年首次出现在新墨西哥附近的西班牙文献中，他们以马和野牛为基础建立经济，以贸易和劫掠网络称雄南部大平原。在18至19世纪，他们阻挡了西班牙、墨西哥和得克萨斯的扩张。疾病、野牛群遭屠杀以及美军的红河战争于1875年终结了他们的独立。

capital.en: No fixed capital; Black Hills (Paha Sapa) as sacred centre
capital.zh: 无固定都城；以黑山（帕哈萨帕）为神圣中心

summary.en: Moving west from the Minnesota woodlands with horses and guns, the seven Lakota bands reached the Black Hills around 1775 and became the dominant power of the northern Plains. Red Cloud's War forced the US to accept the Great Sioux Reservation in the 1868 Fort Laramie Treaty. After gold was found in the Black Hills, war followed; the massacre at Wounded Knee in 1890 ended armed resistance.
summary.zh: 拉科塔七个支族携马匹和枪支从明尼苏达林地西迁，约1775年到达黑山，成为北部大平原的主导力量。红云战争迫使美国在1868年的《拉勒米堡条约》中承认大苏族保留地。黑山发现黄金后战争再起；1890年的伤膝河大屠杀结束了武装抵抗。

sources.title: National Museum of the American Indian: Nation to Nation (Fort Laramie Treaty)

note: The Lakota had no single ruler or fixed start date; 1750 approximates their emergence as a Plains power, and 1890 marks the end of armed resistance, not of the nation. Leaders are listed with approximate dates of prominence. The Lakota (Titonwan) are the western and largest division of the Oceti Sakowin (Seven Council Fires), the confederacy also called the Great Sioux Nation.

summary.en: Hans Egede's mission of 1721 began Dano-Norwegian colonisation, and from 1776 a royal trade monopoly kept Greenland closed to outsiders. Denmark kept it when Norway was lost in 1814. The colony became a Danish county in 1953, gained home rule in 1979 and self-government in 2009, with Greenlandic as its official language and the right to choose independence.
summary.zh: 汉斯·埃格德1721年的传教开启了丹麦—挪威对格陵兰的殖民，1776年起王室贸易垄断使格陵兰对外封闭。1814年丹麦失去挪威但保留了格陵兰。1953年殖民地改为丹麦的一个郡，1979年实行地方自治，2009年实现自治政府，以格陵兰语为官方语言，并拥有选择独立的权利。
